name: Factory Lollipop - Paragraphs
description: Factory Lollipop submodule that adds paragraph and paragraph type FactoryTypes so tests can build valid Paragraphs entities and bundles from Factory Lollipop blueprints.
project_description: factory_lollipop_paragraphs is a submodule of Factory Lollipop that provides the utility APIs for using the factory pattern with the Paragraphs module. It registers two additional FactoryTypes as tagged services (priority 245) on the parent's factory_lollipop.factory_type_resolver collector: ParagraphTypeFactoryType (type string 'paragraph type', creates/loads a paragraphs_type bundle) and ParagraphFactoryType (type string 'paragraph', requires an existing 'type' and creates/persists a paragraph entity). Both receive the entity type manager via setEntityTypeManager and load storage lazily inside create(). It depends on factory_lollipop and paragraphs, and ships no routes, permissions, config, schema, hooks or Drush of its own — it is used only from test/CLI code through the parent module's FixtureFactory service.
